760-001.title: Measure native custody read amplification and define the exact guarded repair
760-001.reason:
UTC: 2026-09-14T07:18:44.665Z
Scope/result truth: preparatory test evidence only; test-green is not product DONE and does not close MASTER3178 D performance. R10's real 10s history candidate remained over deadline and R11 only removed read-time fchmod; neither is recharacterized here. No real history scan or live custody access was performed.
Changed evidence: tests/core/task-attempt-custody-posix-adapter.test.ts:73-85,96-97,361-369,428-444,1151-1235; SHA-256 a9eec57090b1d34f6d9afbac8f17268ec11982d73a668ef7423bcbbe773c3453. FakeNative now counts every invoke and close and tracks live handles.
Actual verification: VITEST_MAX_FORKS=2 npx vitest run --configLoader runner --no-cache tests/core/task-attempt-custody-posix-adapter.test.ts; exit 0; 1 file, 55/55 tests passed. Executed repeated readFirstWriter + readVerified measurements: one-parent path = open-root 2, open-directory-at 2, identity 2, open-file-at 2, read-bounded 2, close-handle 6, total 16; four-parent path = 2, 8, 2, 2, 2, 12, total 28. The depth delta is +6 parent opens and +6 closes for the same two semantic reads. These are operation counts, not elapsed-time or an invented optimized ceiling.
Security evidence: repeated reads performed zero apply-private calls; an unsafe 0600 ancestor was rejected as PRIVACY_UNVERIFIED before read-bounded; injected native identity replacement was rejected as ARTIFACT_CHANGED; successful and rejected paths ended with zero open fake handles. Existing fixture security tests all remained green.
Producer/consumer inspection: TaskAttemptCustodyStore.readFirstWriterSnapshotUncached and readVerifiedSnapshotUncached at src/core/task-attempt-custody-store.ts:13376-13425 call the adapter independently. Adapter readFirstWriter/readVerified at src/core/task-attempt-custody-posix-adapter.ts:1390-1432 funnels each read through openFile; openParentDirectory/openDirectoryComponents at :2388-2491 reopens the bound root and every parent, performs a directory identity reread, then opens/reads/closes the file. Docker consumes repeated verified artifacts at src/orchestra/spawn-backend-docker.ts:12899,14280,14367,14392,14831,14865,14882,15158,15170,15317,15349,15692,15770,15884,15949-15963,17446,20265,20336,20366,20469,20513,20605. Production hashes inspected: adapter f89a7c880fbf464a4c301461d9933b55bcff88e1a15c21797a9a84eee36c63cf; store a0ac403cd35cb7293a59864cee86bee3b701a31cd1d1c475b8e12ca2401cc0b8.
Precise guarded repair recommendation: in a subsequent production-authorized task, add an operation-local read traversal scope in src/core/task-attempt-custody-posix-adapter.ts and thread its lifecycle only through src/core/task-attempt-custody-store.ts / src/core/custody-read-snapshot.ts for one bounded snapshot operation. Reuse the opened, native-pinned root/parent descriptor chain only for reads sharing the exact rootId and parent path, removing duplicate open-root/open-directory-at/close pairs within that operation; never persist it across operations, await gaps, attempts, generations, projects, tenants, or callbacks. Do not cache proof bytes as a substitute for a semantic reread. Retain OWNER_PRIVATE descriptor-relative open on every traversed component; root identity equality against the bound root; per-component returned identity/type/mode validation; the final directory identity reread; file regular-type/private-mode/single-link checks; read-bounded before/after immutable identity equality; proof equality in readVerified; and fail-closed close handling. The last verified file reread and all mount callback post-use root/project/path revalidation fences must remain. If TypeScript facade lifetime cannot express safe scoped reuse, the only permitted widening is a bounded leased-handle/batch operation across native/exec-authority/index.mjs and native/exec-authority/src/custody_posix.c with identical native identity and terminal-close semantics; no global cache or raw fd exposure.
Platform/tenant boundary: current executed evidence is a linux-shaped FakeNative POSIX contract only, not real Linux, macOS, or Windows performance proof. A repair must key scope by rootId + projectId + attemptId/generation and the exact parent path, and must never share across caller tenant/project authority; Windows requires its own adapter evidence and macOS/Linux require real native temporary-fixture runs before platform claims.
Missing host-proof profile: scripts/production-wiring-host-proof-harness.mjs:19-39 and :221-257 registers closure-OS, terminal-native, memory-compact, and metrics profiles but no native-history profile (file SHA-256 26d56698a276bd20d02d4511f235f63b587bd9f12bdeb8858f291b9fab2defd0). Closure must add a new dedicated identity, for example adapterId deckent-native-custody-history-profile-v1, schemaId deckent.host-proof.native-custody-history-profile.v1, and observationGroupId deckent:native-custody-history-profile; it must bind exact built assets, host OS/arch/native ABI, tenant/project corpus digest, command/deadline, before/after operation totals, unchanged semantic result digest, security-fence outcomes, and true exit status. It must run against an isolated authorized corpus and the real native adapter, then demonstrate the owner-approved 10s history budget. It must not reuse closure-os, terminal-native-provider, memory-compact-read-export, or any unrelated profile identity.
docImpact: none; no product or documentation contract changed.

taskSummary.title: Measure native custody read amplification and define the exact guarded repair

evidence: TypeScript FakeNativeCustody counters and a focused Vitest regression were added in tests/core/task-attempt-custody-posix-adapter.test.ts:73-85,96-97,361-369,428-444,1151-1235.
The declared TypeScript/Vitest test file passed 55/55.
Declared command exited 0 with 1 file and 55 tests passed.
Captured stdout reported shallow counts openRoot=2, openDirectoryAt=2, directoryIdentity=2, openFileAt=2, readBounded=2, closeHandle=6, total=16; deep counts 2,8,2,2,2,12,total=28.

The regression proves repeated reads invoke zero apply-private operations, rejects an unsafe 0600 parent before read-bounded, maps injected identity replacement to ARTIFACT_CHANGED, and observes zero open handles after success and both rejection paths.
Existing read-only privacy test and all other scoped tests remained green; no production file changed.

Only tests/core/task-attempt-custody-posix-adapter.test.ts was modified under project write authority; measurements are deterministic FakeNative operation counts, not latency, provider, live-custody, or closure evidence.

Result notes identify the exact adapter/store/consumer call sites, removable operation-local repetition, mandatory security fences, and a new uniquely named host-proof profile boundary in scripts/production-wiring-host-proof-harness.mjs.
No production source or live runtime was written; the sole project mutation is the declared test file.
Actual operation measurements were emitted by the passing test, while privacy, replacement, and cleanup assertions were added rather than weakened.
All preparatory-task requirements and the sole declared verification completed successfully.
